findings.title: Deep link, then a Family link, then ✕ (or Remove) re-opens the drawer, because navigate(-1) lands on the deep-link entry that still has m
findings.fix: Carry baseHasM in the pushed state. On close, navigate(-d) and then strip m with replace once the pop lands. Add AC 24.

findings.title: Esc on a kebab opened with the mouse closes the whole drawer: focus is still inside the panel, so the activeElement-in-menu guard does not fire
findings.fix: Step aside for non-Tab keys whenever a .w360 .menu-list [role=menu] is mounted. Add a mouse variant of AC 21 in Chromium and WebKit.

findings.title: After Remove, setRemoving(null) re-mounts the drawer before the async navigate(-d) pop lands. The seal inerts the page, so the rAF focus on Add a person can do nothing
findings.fix: Add closingId state set in close() and excluded from drawerShown. Call close() before setRemoving(null) in the same batch. AC 11 asserts the drawer never re-appears.

findings.title: The Menu list is portalled to .w360, outside the aria-modal drawer, so VoiceOver may not reach or announce its items
findings.fix: Either portal Menu into the closest [role=dialog] (no transform on .drawer, so position: fixed still works), plus a manual VoiceOver check, or choose D10's text-button alternative.

findings.title: A click on the portalled .menuhead bubbles through React to the row and opens the drawer
findings.fix: Start the handler with: if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.target)) return.

findings.title: 'A deep link or reload has no state' is wrong: history.state survives a reload
findings.fix: Reword to cover new-tab and pasted links only, and note that a reload keeps the depth (still correct behaviour).

findings.title: The sentence placing useStorageNode is in the Dialog.tsx bullet, and isRefusal has no typed status to read
findings.fix: Move the sentence to the groupsData.ts bullet. Throw an Error carrying status, and isRefusal checks status 403 or 404.

findings.title: The spec does not say which ACs depend on D2
findings.fix: List them: AC 6 note, 7, 13, 18 and the card parts of F9/F10 need D2; AC 12 changes under the fallback; the rest are unchanged.

findings.title: The PersonDialog/linkAadhaarCard invalidation item is now verifiable from source
findings.fix: Mark it verified: the link happens before save, and the save invalidates GROUPS. Note the scan-then-Cancel orphan card as out of scope.

findings.title: A base64 photo data URL in person can contain a 12-digit run
findings.fix: Use photo '' in the fixture, or strip data: URLs before scanning.
